description.zh: AKShare 量化研究智能体团队：Alpha 首席量化策略官领衔，携数据官、策略研究员、回测分析师、风控官、报告官五人天团，覆盖 A 股与期货期权的行情获取、指标计算、多因子选股、策略回测、风险控制与复盘报告，坚持“数据说话、回测诚实、风控一票否决”。
description.en: An AKShare quant research team led by Alpha, Chief Quant Officer, with five specialists covering data, signals, backtesting, risk control, and reporting for A-shares and futures/options — data-driven, honest backtests, and risk-control veto.

welcome_message.zh: 告诉我你想研究什么行情、策略或持仓，五人天团随时开工
welcome_message.en: Tell me the quotes, strategy, or position you want to research — the five-member team is ready

description.zh: 拉取股票/指数/期货日线数据并落盘 CSV
description.en: Fetch daily bars for stocks, indices, or futures and save CSV

prompt.zh: 请帮我把 000001 平安银行最近 250 个交易日的日线行情（前复权）下载并保存为 CSV，给出数据身份证。
prompt.en: Please download the last 250 trading days of daily bars (qfq) for 000001, save to CSV, and show the data provenance summary.

description.zh: 基于日线数据统一口径计算 MA/MACD/RSI/BOLL 等指标
description.en: Compute MA/MACD/RSI/BOLL and more on top of daily bars

prompt.zh: 请对我工作区里最近下载的日线 CSV 计算常用技术指标（MA5/10/20/60、MACD、RSI、BOLL、KDJ、ATR），输出带指标列的新 CSV。
prompt.en: Compute common indicators (MA5/10/20/60, MACD, RSI, BOLL, KDJ, ATR) on the most recent daily CSV in my workspace and output a new CSV with indicator columns.

description.zh: 用历史数据验证双均线策略，输出绩效与风险指标
description.en: Validate a dual-MA strategy on history with full performance metrics

prompt.zh: 请回测 000300 指数上的 MA5/MA20 双均线策略（近 3 年，前复权，双边成本 0.1%），给出夏普、最大回撤、胜率与净值曲线。
prompt.en: Backtest an MA5/MA20 dual-MA strategy on the CSI 300 (last 3 years, qfq, 0.1% round-trip cost) and report Sharpe, max drawdown, win rate, and equity curve.

description.zh: 监控主力资金流、龙虎榜与北向资金动向
description.en: Scan mainline money flow, dragon-tiger list, and northbound data

prompt.zh: 请查询今天 A 股主力净流入排名前 10 的行业板块，并简要说明资金动向。
prompt.en: Show today's top-10 A-share industry sectors by mainline net inflow and briefly explain the money-flow trend.

description.zh: 硬条件初筛 + 动量/估值/质量多因子打分
description.en: Hard filters first, then momentum/value/quality factor scoring

prompt.zh: 请按条件筛选 A 股：日成交额 ≥ 2 亿、0 < PE < 40、市值 ≥ 50 亿，按动量/换手/估值打分输出 Top 30。
prompt.en: Screen A-shares: daily turnover ≥ 200M CNY, 0 < PE < 40, market cap ≥ 5B CNY; score by momentum/turnover/valuation and output the Top 30.

description.zh: 单笔风险预算与止损位计算，一票否决
description.en: Per-trade risk budget and stop placement with veto power

prompt.zh: 我有 100 万本金，想在 12.50 买入 000001、止损 11.80，请按单笔 1% 风险预算给出仓位与止损纪律。
prompt.en: With 1,000,000 CNY capital, I want to buy 000001 at 12.50 with a stop at 11.80 — size the position under a 1% per-trade risk budget and state the stop discipline.

zh: 每天「17:30」拉取沪深300 与自选股的日线行情并落盘，简报当日涨跌幅 Top5，任务创建后立即启用
每个交易日「09:35」监控自选股资金流向，主力净流入超过阈值时提醒我，从今天开始持续生效
每周一「09:00」跑一次双均线策略回测（样本近 3 年），输出夏普、最大回撤与净值曲线
每天「18:00」跑多因子选股快照打分，列出新增进入 Top30 的标的与触发因子
每个交易日「21:00」复核当前持仓的仓位与止损位，风控不通过的一票否决并给出调整建议
每月 1 日「09:00」生成上月量化复盘报告：绩效归因、数据口径与固定免责声明
en: Every day at 17:30, fetch daily bars for CSI 300 and my watchlist, save them, and brief the top-5 movers — enable immediately
Every trading day at 09:35, monitor fund flow on my watchlist and alert me when mainline net inflow crosses the threshold, starting today
Every Monday at 09:00, backtest the dual-MA strategy on the last 3 years and report Sharpe, max drawdown, and equity curve
Every trading day at 18:00, run the multi-factor screener and list new entrants into the Top 30 with the triggering factors
Every trading day at 21:00, review position sizing and stops for current holdings; veto anything failing risk control and suggest adjustments
On the 1st of each month at 09:00, produce last month's quant review: performance attribution, data conventions, and the standard disclaimer
